newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening solid after benign PPI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening solid after benign PPI.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open higher after a key inflation indicator showed no signs of creeping inflation, leading analysts to believe current low interest rates might continue.

The U.S. Producer Price Index briefly startled the bond market, which expected a gain of 0.4 percent compared to expectations of 0.2 percent or at most, 0.3 percent. But the core rate, excluding volatile food and energy prices, fell 0.3 percent compared to expectations of a rise of 0.1 percent.
"The core rate is an extraordinarily low number," said Tom Carpenter, chief economist at ASB Capital Management Inc.
